findings.where: Motion sketch, the 'Replay the entrance' control under the timing table (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: This is a button that replays the animation where it is (p7 in the parts map), but it is styled as a text link, in the blue underline the palette keeps for links. So the blue underline means two things on this sheet: 'go somewhere' on the address and the PDF link, and 'do something here' on this one.
findings.who_objects: The founder, or whoever reads the specimen to learn what a link looks like. If they read the underline as navigation, they expect to be taken somewhere and are puzzled when the page stays put. A builder copying the sheet would also carry the mixed signal into the real site.
